name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: activity-panel, braindump, mod-switch.

plugins.name: activity-panel
plugins.description: A side panel showing what Claude is doing right now (thinking, waiting on the model, or stuck on a command) and which files it opened, edited and committed.

plugins.name: braindump
plugins.description: Talk it out like you would to a friend; Claude asks a few questions and turns it into a clear prompt for you to review.

plugins.name: mod-switch
plugins.description: A side panel listing your mods, with an on/off switch for each.
